subject: MAP: ZenWell - MAP draft & timeline update
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft & next steps (ZenWell)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the ZenWell pilot. Highlights: 

- Target close: 2026-09-30 (we flagged this based on your current Q3 launch goal)
- Key milestones: Security review sign-off, Integration (env access) + PoC, Pilot SLA & performance baseline, Procurement/PO issuance
- Owners: ZenWell security -> ZenWell Sec, Redwood SRE -> Rishi Malhotra, Redwood SE -> Dev Patel, Procurement -> Samir/Procurement team
- Dependencies: Access to staging environment by 7/24, SOC2 evidence (we can provide our SOC2 package), PO/contract completion

Action items for us:
1) I’ll send an updated MAP with milestone dates and owners in a follow-up (attached v1.1).
2) Rishi to scope security review checklist and timeline.
3) Dev to confirm integration points and test data needs.

Could you confirm the target close date and add any internal constraints (procurement windows, blackout dates) so we can align the MAP?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0187

Attachment: ZenWell_MAP_v1.1.xlsx

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenwellhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@zenwellhealth.com>, procurement@zenwellhealth.com
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & next steps (ZenWell)

Thanks Marissa — very helpful summary and the MAP looks like a great starting point. A couple of updates from our side after internal sync: 

- We need to push the target close to 2026-10-31 due to our FY2027 budget sign-off (final approvals are not until mid-September). Can you shift milestones accordingly?
- We want to prioritize the security review earlier in the plan (complete by 8/14) so our legal/procurement team has time to review the SOW and terms after security sign-off.
- Please add Samir (copied) as the procurement owner — Samir will handle PO/terms.

Also: can you provide an SOW draft and a ballpark ARR estimate for the pilot (so procurement has a spend number)? Samir — any procurement constraints we should flag (PO process, required docs)?

Appreciate it,
Elena
VP of Digital Transformation | ZenWell Health
elena.torres@zenwellhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & next steps (ZenWell)

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and for flagging the budget timing. We’ll update the MAP to reflect the new target close and the accelerated security milestone. Summary of the proposed changes I’ll publish in v1.2: 

- Target close: 2026-10-31 (moved from 9/30)
- Security review completion: 2026-08-14 (owner: ZenWell Sec / Redwood SRE support — Rishi)
- Env access & integration start: aim to have staging access by 7/24, integration dev window 7/26–8/20 (owner: Dev Patel)
- SOW & pricing: I’ll attach a draft SOW (v1) and an estimated pilot cost line (ballpark ARR for procurement).
- Procurement: Samir will be added as procurement owner; expected PO timeline: 2–4 weeks after SOW approval

Action items committed from Redwood:
- I’ll upload ZenWell_MAP_v1.2 (reforecasted dates) and SOW_draft_zenwell_v1.pdf by EOD today.
- Rishi: please send the security checklist and expected review turnaround by Monday.
- Dev: confirm test-data format and API endpoints needed — can you do that by Monday as well?

CC’ing Aisha from Customer Success to help with pilot onboarding and runbook items. Let me know if you prefer a short sync next week to walk through the revised MAP.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: ZenWell_MAP_v1.2.xlsx

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@zenwellhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@zenwellhealth.com
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & next steps (ZenWell)

Hi Marissa / Elena — looping in procurement details. A few items from our side: 

- Procurement requires a draft SOW and an estimated annual spend to start the PO process. If you can provide a standard terms pdf (or indicate you accept our MSS template), that helps accelerate legal review.
- We typically need 2 weeks for internal approvals once SOW and cost are finalized. If security sign-off is by 8/14, expect PO by ~8/28 (assuming no legal redlines).
- For our finance team we also need an estimated 12‑month spend line for budgeting (ballpark is fine).

Please send SOW and spend estimate and we’ll start intake.

Thanks,
Samir Gupta
Senior Procurement Manager | ZenWell Health
samir.gupta@zenwellhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@zenwellhealth.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenwellhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 13:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & next steps (ZenWell)

Samir — appreciate the clarity. Attached: SOW_draft_zenwell_v1.pdf and an estimated pilot spend line (included in the SOW cover). Quick summary and next steps: 

1) Updated MAP (ZenWell_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) now reflects: target close 2026-10-31; security review complete by 2026-08-14; staging access target 7/24; integration window 7/26–8/20.
2) SOW draft attached — please review and flag any required changes; we are open to MSS template redlines but would like to avoid extended legal negotiation during pilot.
3) Rishi and Dev will produce security checklist and integration spec by Monday (7/13).
4) Can you confirm whether the PO needs any specific vendor forms or W9/PSA paperwork so we can include them in the intake?

Proposed next meeting: quick 30-minute sync week of 7/19 to walk through the MAP and procurement cadence — Elena, Samir, is Tue 7/20 10:00am PT possible?

Thanks — looking forward to aligning timelines.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0187

Attachments: SOW_draft_zenwell_v1.pdf, ZenWell_MAP_v1.2.xlsx
